name: Pit Fiend

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Aura of Fear
traits.details: Any enemy in the aura at the start of the pit fiend’s turn is marked by the pit fiend until the end of the pit fiend’s next turn.

traits.name: Aura of Fire
traits.details: Any enemy that enters the aura or starts its turn there takes 15 fire damage.

effect.description: The pit fiend uses flame-touched mace and tail sting.
Close burst 10 (one or two allies in the burst). The pit fiend teleports each target to a square in the burst.

hit.description: The target takes a -5 penalty to all defenses until the end of the pit fiend’s next turn.

effect.description: Ranged 10 (one devil ally that is lower in level than the pit fiend). The pit fiend slides the target up to 5 squares, and the target drops to 0 hit points and is destroyed. Each creature within 2 squares of the target then takes 3d10 + 9 fire damage.

powers.name: Nightmarish Punishment
powers.trigger: An enemy marked by and within 2 squares of the pit fiend shifts or makes an attack that doesn’t include it as a target.

hit.description: fire damage, and the pit fiend slides the target up to 2 squares to a square adjacent to it.
